thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 502/504 rates observed from apigw-eu-prod (edge) — 12% error rate over 5m. Pager sent to oncall @maria.k :rotating_light:

maria.k: I'm on it. joining call in 1

sanjay: Seeing similar in prod-eu metrics. Latency spike before 502s. Could be upstream timeouts.

maria.k: quick check — rolling out 1% traffic fallback to regional replica? ops-bot can you start traffic-shift play?

ops-bot: @maria.k starting traffic-shift job id=ts-1758502468 -> lambda: shift 1% from apigw-eu-prod to apigw-eu-fallback

jamie: Noted customer impact: a few API calls failing for EU customers, few support tickets. CS alerted.

alex.g: Logs from ingress: 
```
[2025-06-04T12:07:05Z] proxy=apigw-eu code=502 backend_timeout=true backend=infra-gen-01 latency=2.1s
[2025-06-04T12:07:07Z] proxy=apigw-eu code=504 connection_reset upstream=kv-cache
```

sanjay: KV cache spikes at same time — possible upstream overload from a hot prefix.

maria.k: Can we enable short-circuit for heavy prefix caching and reduce max-concurrency on the affected route? Suggest config patch:
```
routes.apigw-eu.prod["/v1/generate"].max_concurrency=8
routes.apigw-eu.prod["/v1/generate"].kv_cache=false
```

ops-bot: Applying config patch to canary 10%... done. Telemetry: error rate down to 8% in canary

jamie: Starting incident doc, filing P1. Noting affected customers list and tickets.

maria.k: Also spinning a temporary autoscale group for infra-gen pool +2 nodes. sanjay can you monitor upstream CPU and queue depth?

sanjay: scaling initiated -> infra-gen +2 nodes, expected join in ~45s

alex.g: Quick grep shows a recent deploy to infra-gen-01 at 2025-06-04T11:59:30. Rollback candidate if scaling doesn't help.

maria.k: If error rate doesn't improve to <3% in 10m, we'll rollback that deploy and notify SRE.

ops-bot: Traffic shift at 1% -> 10% (per runbooks) completed. Overall error rate now 6% and trending down.

incident-bot: Pager update: oncall ack by @maria.k. Incident channel created: #incident-1758502468

jamie: Quick note to billing: hold customer rate-limited retries for EU to avoid cascade. @customer-success-bot sending template

customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers with status: Investigating increased 502/504 in EU region. ETA 30m. :mailbox_with_mail:

sanjay: infra-gen nodes joined. CPU normalizing, queue depth dropping by 40%.

maria.k: Error rate now 2.5% — acceptable threshold. Keep mitigations for 20m and prepare for postmortem runbook.

jamie: Good call on canary config. I'll capture the canary diff and list actions in the incident doc.

alex.g: Recording potential root cause: hot KV prefix + recent infra-gen deploy + insufficient autoscale headroom.

maria.k: Moving to monitoring state. If any regression, pager again. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sanjay: thx. I'll follow up with logs and grafana snapshots.

ops-bot: Autoscale group removed extra nodes after stable period.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing pager. Incident ID 1758502468.
